caption:
"Where did this lead come from?" If you can't answer that in five seconds, you don't have marketing. You have hope with a budget.

This is the least glamorous and highest-return thing a beginner can set up, and it takes one afternoon:

→ A different link for each channel
→ A different code or offer phrase for each partnership
→ One question on the form: how did you find us
→ One place where all of it lands

That's it. Now every month you can see which half of the spend was the half that worked — the thing John Wanamaker famously could not.

Without it, you're making budget decisions on vibes, and you will keep funding the channel that feels busiest rather than the one that pays. Those are almost never the same channel.

Attribution isn't advanced. It's the floor.
